description: This file defines outbound Telegram messaging functions, including message sending, polling, and configuration, with lazy loading of modules and runtime resolution.

methods.name: loadTelegramSendModule
methods.description: Lazy loads the send.js module asynchronously.

methods.name: getOptionalTelegramRuntime
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the Telegram runtime, returns null if unavailable.

methods.name: resolveTelegramSend
methods.description: Resolves the function to send Telegram messages, with dependency injection and fallback.

methods.name: sendMessageTelegramLazy
methods.description: Lazy loads and sends a Telegram message.

methods.name: sendPollTelegramLazy
methods.description: Lazy loads and sends a Telegram poll.

methods.name: sendTypingTelegramLazy
methods.description: Lazy loads and sends a typing indicator in Telegram.

methods.name: resolveTelegramTokenHelper
methods.description: Resolves the function to obtain a Telegram token, with runtime fallback.

methods.name: buildTelegramSendOptions
methods.description: Constructs options for sending Telegram messages based on parameters.

methods.name: sendTelegramOutbound
methods.description: Sends a Telegram message with specified parameters.
